# Idun SDK

> Thin client + CLI for the Azure AI Foundry agent NatureLM-Idun-5-MoE.
> Stdlib-only (urllib, no httpx/azure.identity) for Termux/Android.
> Idun is a tool agent: it reasons and calls web_search / memory_search.
> Multi-backend (v0.1.31+): same IdunClient API dispatches to
> azure (default), hf (Hugging Face), github (GitHub Models), openai (OpenAI-compatible).
> Non-Azure backends need no FOUNDRY_TOKEN.

## Documentation

- [README](README.md) — install, full setup (all backends), multi-backend, CLI usage
- [ROADMAP](ROADMAP.md) — status quo + phases 2-4
- [MCP server](idun_mcp.py) — stdlib-only stdio MCP server (idun_chat, idun_trace)

## Install

- `pip install idun-sdk` (Python >= 3.8, no third-party deps)
- verify: `idun --help`, `idun welcome`

## Setup (per backend)

- `idun wizard` — universal first-run setup, writes `~/.idunrc`
- `idun status` — show active backend + credential state
- azure:   `idun login`                 -> `~/foundry_token.txt` (device-code, no admin role)
- hf:      `idun login --backend hf`    -> `~/hf_token.txt` / `HF_TOKEN`
- github:  `idun login --backend github`-> `~/github_token.txt` / `GITHUB_TOKEN`
- openai:  `idun login --backend openai` -> `~/openai_token.txt` / `OPENAI_API_KEY`
- switch:  `export IDUN_BACKEND=hf` (global) or `idun chat --backend github "..."` (one-off)
- config override envs: `HF_MODEL`, `GITHUB_MODEL`, `OPENAI_MODEL`, `OPENAI_BASE`

## Key API

- `IdunClient(token=None, backend="azure", base=..., project=..., agent=...,
  hf_token=..., hf_model=..., github_token=..., github_model=...,
  openai_token=..., openai_model=..., openai_base=..., timeout=600)` — reads `FOUNDRY_TOKEN` /
  `IDUN_BACKEND` / per-backend tokens from env or args.
- `client.complete(prompt, max_output_tokens=1024) -> IdunResult` — returns
  `text` (final answer) + `steps` (agent trajectory: kind=reasoning|tool).
  On non-Azure backends `steps == []` (flat answer, no tool-agent trace).
- `IdunClient._build_payload(prompt)` — verified Azure shape
  `{"model":"model-router","input":prompt,"max_output_tokens":N}` (NO `tools` key).
- CLI: `idun wizard | idun login [--backend X] | idun status |
  idun chat --backend X "<prompt>" | idun trace "<prompt>" |
  idun packs | idun run <pack> <key> | idun diff "<a>" "<b>" | idun export`.
  - `idun openapi` — print bundled OpenAPI 3 spec for the completion API
  (`idun openapi > openapi.json`).

## Agent trajectory shape

Each step in `IdunResult.steps` is a `Step`:
- `kind="reasoning"` -> `text` (assistant plan)
- `kind="tool"` -> `tool="web_search"`, `query`, `status`

This makes Idun a visible tool agent, not a chatbot wheel.

## Optional MCP

- `python3 idun_mcp.py` — stdio MCP server exposing `idun_chat` and `idun_trace`.
- GitMCP docs mirror: https://gitmcp.io/qapdex-maker/idun-sdk
